resources.string: Ready. With \"Catch Crash\" enabled, crashes are reported to Crashlytics without closing the app.
On launch: sample non-fatal exception sent to Crashlytics.\n\nCatch Crash is ON — tap Cause Crash to test; you will see on-screen feedback and the app stays open.
Catch mode ON — the app will stay open and show feedback when a crash is reported.
Catch mode OFF — the next crash will close the app and be reported as a fatal crash.
Caught crash #%1$d at %2$s\nNullPointerException reported to Crashlytics as non-fatal. Check Firebase Console → Crashlytics.
Fatal crash in 1s — the app will close. Crashlytics will record this as a crash.
API key is invalid. API call failed.
